lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Tuesday's HARC meeting, where the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave goes before the commission for three separate Preliminary Large-Scale public hearings covering multiple new buildings in Backman Village — the kind of project that sets a tone for what this town becomes. Also Tuesday, the Board of County Commissioners takes up two Land Use Code amendments, one on Natural Medicine Businesses and one on Nonconforming Lots, both of which quietly shape what gets built and where across the county.

notable.stake: Public hearings on major multi-building Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave.
HARC reviews alterations to Town Hall landmark and a floor-area addition at Parks office.
BOCC considers Land Use Code changes on psychedelic businesses and nonconforming lots.
Open Space Commission site walk includes public comment opportunity at Valley Floor.
